name: Texas

fees.note: General single-trip permit fee $60 (Texas.gov adds $0.25 + 2.25% card fee, not included). When the load is also overweight, the $60 is included in the overweight line instead (one permit).

$60 permit + highway maintenance fee ($150/$225/$300/$375 by gross) + vehicle supervision fee ($35 for 200,001-254,300 lb with >=95 ft axle spacing; $500 for super heavy). 200,001-254,300 lb with <95 ft axle spacing or any axle group over max permit weight is super heavy: $935, not $470.

restrictions.text: Daytime only (30 min before sunrise to 30 min after sunset) unless permit authorizes night travel. Night allowed for overweight-only loads, or on Interstate when not over 10 ft wide / 100 ft long with legal overhangs.

No movement over 14 ft wide, 16 ft high or 110 ft long on New Year's Day, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving Day or Christmas Day - the holiday date itself (unless TxDMV grants an exception).

No movement over 14 ft wide, 16 ft high or 110 ft long on New Year's Day, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving Day or Christmas Day - the holiday date itself (unless TxDMV grants an exception).

No movement over 14 ft wide, 16 ft high or 110 ft long on New Year's Day, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving Day or Christmas Day - the holiday date itself (unless TxDMV grants an exception).
TxDOT district curfews apply (commonly 7-9 AM and 4-6 PM Mon-Fri in metro areas); check the district restriction lists and the conditions printed on the permit.

notes: Super heavy: >254,300 lb gross, any axle group over max permit weight, or 200,001-254,300 lb with <95 ft overall axle spacing. Apply 6-8 weeks ahead (Form MCD-305).
TxDMV may require law-enforcement escorts depending on size, route or nature of the load (no fixed numeric trigger published).
Escort road mapping is approximate: Texas rule says 'two-lane highway' (front) vs 'divided/four-lane highway' (rear), not interstate vs non-interstate.
